prompt_templates.not_applicable_prompt: Not applicable. This study does not use LLMs, prompt engineering, or natural-language generation. All model inputs are numeric feature vectors and all outputs are probability scores, interpretability ratios, fairness statistics, and SHAP attributions.
prompt_templates.documentation_prompt: Not applicable. Documentation is written manually in the paper's Code and Data Availability section; no automated prompt template is used.

partitioning_parameters.stratification_preserves: marginal positive-class rate in each partition

algorithm_placeholder: 1. Start with 20 quantile bins on the training partition.
3. Enforce monotonicity by merging adjacent bins whose WoE sequence changes direction.
4. Enforce a minimum bin frequency of 5% of training observations per bin; merge the least-frequent bin with its closest-WoE neighbour if violated.
binning.algorithm_status: UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT — the procedure above is a rational placeholder; any monotonicity-preserving supervised binner is acceptable, but it must be frozen on training data only.

logistic_branch_encoding.rare_category_rule: assign neutral WoE = 0 for categories unseen in training
logistic_branch_encoding.rare_category_rationale: preserves log-odds-zero contribution; prevents information leakage
logistic_branch_encoding.class_convention: g_k = count of y=0 observations in bin k; b_k = count of y=1 observations in bin k; G = total y=0; B = total y=1
logistic_branch_encoding.class_convention_status: UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT — orientation documented to prevent silent coefficient-sign drift

boosting_branch_encoding.unknown_level_rule: all-zero indicator vector for levels unseen in training

information_value_filter.zindi_result: all ten features pass the filter

smote_ablation.source: inherited from Kanziga (2026), reported in Section 5.1

scale_pos_weight.formula_status: UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT — formula and value are rational placeholders; value must be recomputed from the actual training partition

preprocessing_parameters.dropped_column_rationale: uniqueid: unique-per-row; year: perfectly collinear with country

variable_definitions.g_k: count of y=0 (negative-class) observations in bin k
variable_definitions.b_k: count of y=1 (positive-class) observations in bin k

woe_parameters.logic_for_lr: WoE-transformed features + L2 regularization preserve the auditable per-feature decomposition regulators require (Section 3.1)
woe_parameters.orientation_note: For Zindi, y=1 = bank_account=1. This makes b_k count account-owners. Sign reversal is harmless to metrics but must be kept consistent.

iv_parameters.purpose: feature selection for the logistic regression component only

logistic_regression_parameters.role: interpretable linear baseline; provides auditable coefficients

residual_xgboost_parameters.residual_choice_rationale: direct regression target; aligns with residual-learning paradigm (He et al., 2016)
residual_xgboost_parameters.h_m: regression tree fitted at iteration m
residual_xgboost_parameters.shallow_depth_rationale: deeper trees allow boosting to dominate and erode the interpretability ratio (Section 5.2)
residual_xgboost_parameters.low_learning_rate_rationale: encourages gradual residual correction, not aggressive replacement of the logistic baseline (Section 5.2)

lightgbm_sensitivity_parameters.purpose: sensitivity check on the residual learner
lightgbm_sensitivity_parameters.configuration: mirror the residual XGBoost settings as closely as possible; use objective='regression', learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=7 (approximating max_depth=3), subsample=0.8, feature_fraction=0.8, lambda_l2=2
lightgbm_sensitivity_parameters.configuration_status: UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT — mirror settings are rational placeholders

adaptive_weighting_parameters.gamma_constraint: gamma > 0 (controlling the concavity of the uncertainty-to-weight mapping)

cross_validation_strategy.manuscript_inconsistency_note: Table 1 states 3-fold for adaptive; Section 3.4 states 5-fold for all three. This config resolves to 5-fold. UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT which is authoritative.

interpretability_parameters.threshold_status: indicative rather than theoretical; sensitivity evaluated empirically (Section 3.3)
interpretability_parameters.probability_scale_caveat: rho defined on the probability scale; high-p_LR observations are mechanically placed in the fully interpretable region
interpretability_parameters.label_parity_caveat: rho is not invariant under label reversal (y -> 1-y); interpretation tied to positive-class convention (default in Taiwan, account ownership in Zindi)

two_stage_training.stage_1: fit logistic regression on WoE-transformed features
two_stage_training.stage_2: fit XGBoost on raw response residuals r_i = y_i - p_LR(x_i)
two_stage_training.hyperparameter_tuning: performed on training + validation partitions only
two_stage_training.platt_calibration: fitted on held-out validation fold only

alternating_minimization_scheme.joint_loss_formula: L(beta, f_GBM) = sum_{i=1}^N ell( y_i, clip(p_LR(x_i; beta) + alpha*(x_i; beta) * f_GBM(x_i), 0, 1) ) + lambda_LR * ||beta||_2^2 + Omega(f_GBM)
alternating_minimization_scheme.alpha_star_recomputation: MANDATORY: alpha*(x) depends on p_LR(x; beta) through u_LR(x) = 4 p_LR(1-p_LR). At every alternating-minimization iteration, recompute p_LR and u_LR from the updated beta before recomputing alpha* and the fused prediction.
alternating_minimization_scheme.step_1: hold f_GBM fixed; update beta by L-BFGS on joint loss
alternating_minimization_scheme.step_2: hold beta fixed; refit f_GBM on updated response residuals
alternating_minimization_scheme.implementation_caveat: step 2 minimizes squared error on residuals, not the joint binary cross-entropy; the scheme is NOT exact coordinate descent on L
alternating_minimization_scheme.deployment_default: two-stage training retained as operational default

calibration_parameters.fitted_on: held-out validation fold (validation logits per Table 1)

discrimination_metrics.auc: Area Under the ROC Curve on test partition

calibration_metrics.ece: Expected Calibration Error, K = 10 equal-width bins
calibration_metrics.reliability_diagram: observed accuracy vs confidence per bin

interpretability_behaviour_metrics.rho_distribution: distribution of rho(x) on test partition
interpretability_behaviour_metrics.region_shares: share of test observations in each of the three regions
interpretability_behaviour_metrics.region_base_rates: within-region default rate (Taiwan) or positive-class rate (Zindi)
interpretability_behaviour_metrics.per_region_auc: LR AUC and Hybrid AUC computed within each region

evaluation_metrics_parameters.threshold_recalibration_note: operational thresholds typically use cost-sensitive optimisation or Youden's J, not 0.5 (Section 6.1)

education.placeholder_status: UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT - the bucket for 'Vocational/Specialised training' and 'Other/Dont know/RTA' is a registered placeholder. Vocational is assigned to 'secondary or above' on empirical grounds: that assignment reproduces the Table 4 test cells to within 21 observations, against 173 for the alternative, a gap far exceeding the observed split noise. 'Other/Dont know/RTA' (35 rows) is below the resolution of that constraint and follows the convention the original configuration already applied to 'Other' and 'Don't know/Refused'.

fairness_audit_parameters.disparate_impact_formula: DI(g) = Pr[y_hat = 1 | A = g] / Pr[y_hat = 1 | A = g_ref]
fairness_audit_parameters.four_fifths_origin: U.S. EEOC 1978 Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures
fairness_audit_parameters.four_fifths_status: reference threshold only; not a decision rule (Section 3.8)

statistics_computed.per_region: restricted to each of the three interpretability regions

fairness_audit_parameters.post_treatment_caveat: rho(x) is causally downstream of X; per-region DI/EOD are descriptive stratifications, not causal fairness metrics (Rosenbaum, 1984)
fairness_audit_parameters.region_conditional_interpretation: should not be read as 'fairness within the region'
fairness_audit_parameters.degenerate_cell_handling: ML-driven region has no predicted positives for reference groups; DI/EOD reported as '---' (undefined), not zero (Tables 5 and 6)

thin_file_parameters.construction: sum of standardised components: index = z_education + z_cellphone + z_formaljob
thin_file_parameters.definition: bottom quartile of the composite index, threshold applied INCLUSIVELY (index <= tau)

hypotheses_tested.h1: residual learner contributes more for thin-file borrowers (hybrid AUC gain over LR larger on thin-file)
hypotheses_tested.h1_result: supported: +0.058 on thin-file vs +0.015 full population
hypotheses_tested.h2: rho(x) distribution shifted toward smaller values on thin-file subgroup
hypotheses_tested.h2_result: not supported: mean rho 0.718 thin-file vs 0.703 full test set

thin_file_parameters.mapping_placeholder_status: UNSPECIFIED IN MANUSCRIPT - 'Formally employed Government' and 'Formally employed Private' are the Zindi spellings of the categories the original configuration named 'Government' and 'Formally employed Private sector', and inherit their value of 1. 'Government Dependent', 'Other Income', 'No Income' and 'Dont Know/Refuse to answer' denote absence of formal employment and take 0, following the convention the original configuration applied to 'Other' and 'Don't know/Refused'. The declared subgroup size does NOT uniquely determine this mapping: 79 of 504 candidate mappings satisfy n = 1559 +/- 20, so the assignment is settled semantically and the target is used only as a consistency check.
thin_file_parameters.tie_handling: The composite index is built from three discrete components and takes only 15 distinct values, so ties at tau are massive: 496 test rows sit exactly at tau. A strict comparison (index < tau) yields n = 1053 (22.4% of test); the inclusive comparison (index <= tau) yields n = 1553 (33.0%), against the declared 1559 (33.1%). The manuscript's own subgroup size therefore requires the INCLUSIVE rule. The shipped implementation uses the strict rule and must be corrected.

hard_soft_split_parameters.interpretation_of_rho_approximately_one: decision explainable from hard demographics alone
hard_soft_split_parameters.interpretation_of_rho_below_0.7: soft behavioural proxies materially shifted the outcome
hard_soft_split_parameters.methodological_status: reported as a methodological note rather than headline contribution (Section 3.7)
hard_soft_split_parameters.limitation: soft block on Zindi is modest in width

joint_optimization_parameters.joint_loss_formula: L(beta, f_GBM) = sum_{i=1}^N ell( y_i, clip(p_LR(x_i; beta) + alpha*(x_i; beta) * f_GBM(x_i), 0, 1) ) + lambda_LR * ||beta||_2^2 + Omega(f_GBM)
joint_optimization_parameters.step_1: hold f_GBM fixed; update beta by L-BFGS on L
joint_optimization_parameters.step_2: hold beta fixed; refit f_GBM on updated response residuals r_i = y_i - p_LR(x_i; beta)
joint_optimization_parameters.alpha_star_recomputation: MANDATORY: recompute p_LR, u_LR, and alpha* from the updated beta at every fixed-point iteration before constructing the fused prediction.
joint_optimization_parameters.implementation_caveat: step 2 minimizes squared error on residuals, not the joint binary cross-entropy; the scheme is NOT coordinate descent on L

bootstrap_inference_parameters.auc_stratification: within positive-class and negative-class strata separately

delong_test_parameters.method: DeLong test for correlated ROC curves
delong_test_parameters.implementation: fast midrank algorithm of Sun and Xu (2014)
delong_test_parameters.floor_boundedness_note: DeLong provides an asymptotic z-statistic and p-value not floor-bounded by bootstrap resample count (Section 5.6)

shap_explanation_parameters.shap_decomposition_preserved: attributions restricted to residual component to preserve additive decomposition of Equation (5)
shap_explanation_parameters.stability_metric: bootstrap standard deviation of feature rank
shap_explanation_parameters.reported_top_k_set_preservation: top-5 feature set preserved in 74.0% of resamples
shap_explanation_parameters.instability_interpretation: treated as a flag on individual explanations, not a property of the framework (Section 3.6)

essential_methodological_notes.zindi_target_reframing: bank-account ownership is used as a deliberate proxy for the eligibility gate; not a default label (Section 4.2)
essential_methodological_notes.rho_probability_scale_caveat: the interpretability ratio is defined on the probability scale; high-p_LR borrowers are mechanically routed to the fully interpretable region (Section 3.3)
essential_methodological_notes.rho_label_parity_caveat: rho is not invariant to label reversal; positive-class convention is default (Taiwan) and account ownership (Zindi)
essential_methodological_notes.four_fifths_reference_status: the [0.8, 1.25] interval is only a reference threshold, not a decision rule (Section 3.8)
essential_methodological_notes.post_treatment_conditioning_caveat: conditioning on rho(x) is conditioning on a post-treatment variable; per-region DI/EOD are descriptive, not causal (Section 3.8; Rosenbaum 1984)
essential_methodological_notes.degenerate_ml_driven_region: the ML-driven region has near-empty predicted-positive cells for reference groups; DI/EOD are undefined there, not zero (Tables 5, 6)
essential_methodological_notes.multiple_comparison_adjustment: not applied; consistent with the descriptive-audit intent (Section 5.6)
essential_methodological_notes.structural_vs_model_disparity: the audit detects disparities but does not by itself disentangle structural population inequality from model-induced disparity (Section 7.4)
essential_methodological_notes.alternating_minimization_not_coordinate_: the step that refits the residual learner minimizes squared error on residuals, so the scheme is not exact coordinate descent on the joint loss (Section 3.10)
essential_methodological_notes.calibration_source: the LR + Platt ablation shows the calibration gain comes from Platt scaling, while the residual learner contributes the discrimination gain (Section 6.1)
essential_methodological_notes.thin_file_rho_hypothesis: the hypothesis that thin-file implies lower rho was not supported; thin-file borrowers are confidently predicted negative by LR, reducing the residual weight (Section 6.4)
